name: vllm_cutlass_pack_scale_fp8
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_cutlass_pack_scale_fp8.py. Packs an fp8 (float8_e4m3fn) scale tensor of shape (rows,cols) via vLLM _custom_ops.cutlass_pack_scale_fp8 and returns the packed tensor. Input is built in gen_inputs because float8_e4m3fn cannot be produced by the server's random generator: randn fp32 cast to float8_e4m3fn, matching the test. Comparison is exact (integer/byte packing). No torch fallback; requires vLLM at eval time.
